description: Takes a positioning statement, your target customer and the key benefit, and returns copy to edit for the channels you choose: a website hero, a LinkedIn tagline and post drafts, a three-email cold sequence, a sales deck outline and a 15-minute demo script, with calls to action that fit your business model and the order to work the channels in. Optional channels, product name and business model shape it.

business_model.description: How you sell (saas, services, connectivity, transactions, marketplace, hardware_software or investment). Used to choose calls to action and commercial terms; read from your inputs when not given

channels.description: Which channels to cover, from website, linkedin, cold_email, sales_deck and product_demo. Others are listed as not covered; with none, all five are covered

key_benefit.description: Primary benefit, written as an action (for example "fix critical exposures first")

your_sector.description: Your company's own industry (not your customers'). When given, it decides the sector notes; when left out, the tool reads it from your words and stays neutral if they are unclear.

name: impact_translate_execution
title: Translate Execution
